title: Scheduled tasks
statusUnavailable: The next and last runs are not available right now.

empty.title: No scheduled tasks
empty.text: Create a task to run a script, fetch a URL or run a backup plan on a schedule.

task.deleteText: The task and its timer are removed. Its past output stays in the system journal.
task.rootNote: This task runs as root. Saving a root task may ask for your password, and root tasks only run while root terminals are allowed: switching root terminals off stops them.
task.rootOff: Root terminals are switched off right now, so this task will not run.
task.scriptHint: Up to {size}. "#!/bin/sh" is added when the script has no first line starting with "#!".
task.urlHint: The server requests this address at each run; an answer other than 2xx counts as a failure.
task.noPlans: There is no backup plan yet. Create one on the Backups page.
task.enabledHint: When off, the task keeps its settings but does not run on its schedule.
task.sheetIntro: Each task is a systemd service with a timer.
task.timeoutHint: A run that takes longer is stopped (at most {max} minutes).
task.userHint: A site owner, a login user or, where allowed, root.

steps.create: Create the systemd service and timer of {name}
steps.update: Rewrite the systemd service and timer of {name}
steps.disabled: Leave it off until it is enabled

task.userHintSites: A site owner. Tasks as root or other users are for administrators.
task.userNote: This user is not a site owner and may be able to use sudo: as with root tasks, changing, running and deleting this task take the administrator permission, and saving may ask for your password.

schedule.customHint: A systemd OnCalendar expression, for example "Mon..Fri *-*-* 09:00:00" or "*-*-01,15 04:30:00".
schedule.shortMonths: Months without this day are skipped.

runs.intro: The newest runs with their output, as the system journal keeps them.
runs.empty: The task has not run yet.
runs.pick: Pick a run to see its output.
runs.truncated: Only the end of the output is shown.

typeHint.shell: Run a shell script as a site owner or another user
typeHint.url: Request an address; an answer other than 2xx counts as a failure

drawer.scriptHidden: Hidden: scripts can hold passwords, so only accounts that may change this task see them.
drawer.urlHidden: Hidden: addresses can hold keys, so only accounts that may change this task see them.
